---
name: Support for a new cloud
about: Suggest a cloud for CryptBridge, or offer to add it
title: "Support for <cloud name>"
labels: ["enhancement", "help wanted"]
---

**Which cloud?**
<!-- Its name, and rclone's backend name if you know it (see https://rclone.org/overview/). -->

**Does it work with plain rclone?**
<!-- Have you used rclone crypt with this cloud yourself? Anything special you noticed? -->

**How do you sign in?**
<!-- In the browser, with e-mail and password, with an API key, ... -->

**Would you like to add it yourself?**
<!-- Yes / I can help test / No, just a wish. All are welcome! -->
